entities.summary: Dominik Kahun is a Czech-born German professional ice hockey player who is a forward for Lausanne HC of the National League (NL). He previously has played for the Chicago Blackhawks, Pittsburgh Penguins, Buffalo Sabres and Edmonton Oilers of the National Hockey League (NHL).
